findings.detail: Command-versus-pipeline selection is interleaved with planned-versus-direct dispatch, producing four invocation sites. Adding a shared dispatch option requires synchronized edits, and reviewers must compare all four branches to establish equivalent journal and target wiring.
findings.fix: Select the runner and payload first, then use one planned dispatch branch and one direct dispatch branch. Keep error recording together.
findings.title: Uncited: Runner selection repeats the optional-plan dispatch logic.

findings.detail: The inventory check and mutation-syntax check independently parse another test's source to recover local declarations. Both depend on its method name, variable names and assignment shapes. Moving the mutation list into a constant or accessor therefore requires updating source-extraction machinery unrelated to the assertions being checked.
findings.fix: Expose mutation declarations as shared test data consumed directly by execution and validation. Retain the independent expected-detector inventory and AST validation of mutated source.
findings.title: Uncited: Declarative test data is recovered through implementation-specific AST traversal.

strengths: Deadline allocation and process launches have centralized boundaries.
Fingerprint planning and execution share operation declarations.
summary: Reviewed all 162 membership paths and their committed diffs for abstraction consistency. Two optional cleanup suggestions identify concrete maintenance costs. The review remained read-only; tests were not run.
